fix: Make the minter satisfy the catalog contract at mint time: either (a) mint with a self-describing stub template (description='Runtime-minted stub for <name>; not yet defined' + when_to_use marking it non-selectable) that the guard accepts explicitly, or (b) mint into an untracked staging area (.evolve/phases-pending/) promoted only with metadata. Wiring proof: a test that mints an unknown phase name through the LIVE mint path and asserts the merged catalog stays guard-green.
notes: Same sweep mechanism as the gate-wiring-proof incident (#399) and cycle-1262 audit F3. Manifest gate (shadow) observed but could not block. | [2ND INSTANCE 2026-08-04, PROFILES] runtime-minted profile stubs (ship-stage-hygiene-check.json, regression-predicate-precheck.json: empty cli, no persona pairing) rode a queue ship into tracking and FAILED the v22.13.0 release suite (TestSmoke_RealProfiles + TestRepoPersonaProfilePairing) — release auto-demoted to prerelease by the #394 net. The class is MINT-WIDE (phases AND profiles): minted config must satisfy repo contracts at mint time or live outside tracking. Weight 0.85→0.9.
summary: cycle-1262's scout window minted .evolve/phases/ship-stage-hygiene-check/phase.json with empty description/when_to_use; ship's whole-tree bind tracked it; TestPhaseCatalog_OptionalPhasesHaveSelectMetadata went RED on main (both platforms) — the guard is repo-wide but per-cycle changed-scope never runs it (scope disease costume #4). Console-first fix added honest metadata to THIS stub; the CLASS remains: every future mint of an unknown phase name re-creates the hazard.
title: Runtime phase-mint writes metadata-less stubs that break the repo-wide catalog guard when ship sweeps them into tracking
